from: S3-E2 (version 65): “Allow horizontal scrolling when technician columns exceed the available viewport; never hide technicians automatically. The board’s sideways scrollbar is 16px thick, and its grab handle is never shorter than 150px at any screen width or number of technician columns. When more of the board fits on screen, the handle is longer, as the browser draws it. The scrollbars inside each column are unchanged. Firefox shows its own standard scrollbar.” (The scroll bar size is checked in its own case: Board View’s sideways scroll bar is thick and its handle is never tiny.)
to: S3-E2 (version 81, 27 Oct 2026): “Allow horizontal scrolling when technician columns exceed the available viewport; never hide technicians automatically. The board shows no sideways scrollbar, in any browser; it scrolls sideways with the minimap (S3-E2a), a trackpad, or Shift with the mouse wheel. The scrollbars inside each column are unchanged.” (The minimap is checked in its own case: Board View’s minimap scrolls the board, and no sideways scroll bar shows.)
